entries.head:
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, July 9, 2019/Ashadha 18, 1941 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Ayurveda,  Yoga  &  Naturopathy,  Unani,  Siddha  and  Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Corporate Affairs; Culture; Earth Sciences; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; New and Renewable Energy; Power; Science and
Technology; Tourism)
Total number of questions — 160
Inclination for allopathy treatment
1734. SHRIMATI JHARNA DAS
BAIDYA: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether people in rural and urban
areas are still inclined towards allopathy
despite publicity given to AYUSH by
Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof and reasons
therefor; and
(c) whether more persons in urban areas
are using AYUSH treatment than in rural
areas?
Outcome of Delhi Declaration 2013
1735. DR. VINAY P.
SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister
of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) how has the knowledge sharing
between South East Asian Countries
improved post the Delhi Declaration 2013
and which countries in South East Asia
have co-ordinated with India in this regard;
(b) how many regional centres have
been established in accordance with the
Declaration for capacity building and
networking in areas of traditional medicine
and medicinal plants; and
(c) with how many of these signatories
of Delhi Declaration, has India shared its
knowledge on traditional medicine?
Promoting Y oga in rural areas
1736. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPA THY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any special initiatives have
been taken by Government for promotion
of Yoga on the eve of International Y oga
Day, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether it is a fact that steps taken
to promote Yoga are mostly restricted to
391

392
the urban areas of the country and if so, the
reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government proposes to
promote Yoga in rural and backward areas
of the country with same enthusiasm as in
urban areas of the country?
Homoeopathic facility in Government
hospitals
1737. SHRI SANJAY SETH: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) the percentage of Government
hospitals in India which provide
homoeopathic (or other alternate medicine)
facilities in addition to other regular
facilities;
(b) whether these facilities can be set
up in every major Government hospital to
ease the financial burden of allopathic
treatment on patients wherever possible;
and
(c) if so, what steps are being/shall be
taken by Government in this direction?
Digitisation and publication of
textbooks and manuscripts
related with AYUSH
1738. SHRI G.C. CHANDRA-
SHEKHAR: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry has
successfully implemented the scheme for
acquisition, cataloguing, digitisation and
publication of textbooks and manuscripts
related with Ayurveda, Yoga and
Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and
Homoeopathy;
(b) if so, the number of manuscripts
that have been digitised and translated till
date;
(c) the number of languages in which
the translations are being done including
Kannada;
(d) the number of languages in which
the texts are still to be translated; and
(e) whether a dedicated portal/web-
based system has been developed for access
and retrieval of these texts by users across
the globe?
Homoeopathy as alternative to
allopathy
1739. SHRIMATI SHANTA
CHHETRI: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPA THY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
allopathic treatment is fast becoming
beyond the common man's means;
(b) whether Government is aware that
homoeopathy treatment is by far the
cheapest and requires the highest attention
of Government to promote its research and
development so that it can be an alternative
for the poor; and
(c) if so, what measures Government
has taken so far in this regard and the details
thereof?
Schemes for promotion of AYUSH
1740. SHRI RAM KUMAR
KASHYAP: W ill the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPA THY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the schemes being
implemented/lying pending for promotion

393
of Unani, Homoeopathy, Ayurveda, Y oga
and Naturopathy and the amount of funds
allocated and spent for the said purpose
during the last three years;
(b) whether Government proposes to
allot any special amount of funds for
promoting the said systems of medicine at
several health centres in the country, State/
UT-wise details thereof; and
(c) the details of Naturopathy and Y oga
Hospitals empanelled by Central
Government Health Scheme (CGHS) and
Delhi Government Employees Health
Scheme (DGEHS) for Y oga & Naturopathy
treatments/procedures in Delhi together
